arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَيلٌ لِلمُطَفِّفينَ
translation: Woe unto the defrauders

arabic: الَّذينَ إِذَا اكتالوا عَلَى النّاسِ يَستَوفونَ
transliteration: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona
translation: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full
But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss
Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
Unto an Awful Day
The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds

arabic: كَلّا إِنَّ كِتٰبَ الفُجّارِ لَفى سِجّينٍ
transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
translation: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin
Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is
A written record
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Those who deny the Day of Judgment

arabic: وَما يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلّا كُلُّ مُعتَدٍ أَثيمٍ
transliteration: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin
translation: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor

arabic: إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِ ءايٰتُنا قالَ أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
translation: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old

arabic: كَلّا بَل رانَ عَلىٰ قُلوبِهِم ما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
transliteration: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
translation: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts

arabic: كَلّا إِنَّهُم عَن رَبِّهِم يَومَئِذٍ لَمَحجوبونَ
transliteration: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona
translation: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord
Then lo! they verily will burn in hell

arabic: ثُمَّ يُقالُ هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
transliteration: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
translation: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny

arabic: كَلّا إِنَّ كِتٰبَ الأَبرارِ لَفى عِلِّيّينَ
transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena
translation: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin
Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is
A written record
Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)
Lo! the righteous verily are in delight
On couches, gazing
Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight
They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed

arabic: خِتٰمُهُ مِسكٌ وَفى ذٰلِكَ فَليَتَنافَسِ المُتَنٰفِسونَ
transliteration: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona
translation: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss
And mixed with water of Tasnim
A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ أَجرَموا كانوا مِنَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا يَضحَكونَ
transliteration: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
translation: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed
And wink one to another when they passed them

arabic: وَإِذَا انقَلَبوا إِلىٰ أَهلِهِمُ انقَلَبوا فَكِهينَ
transliteration: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
translation: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting

arabic: وَإِذا رَأَوهُم قالوا إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ لَضالّونَ
transliteration: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
translation: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray
Yet they were not sent as guardians over them

arabic: فَاليَومَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنَ الكُفّارِ يَضحَكونَ
transliteration: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona
translation: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers
On high couches, gazing

arabic: هَل ثُوِّبَ الكُفّارُ ما كانوا يَفعَلونَ
transliteration: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
translation: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do
